According to the course material, how many types of Join are there? (answer in figures)
two

There are 2 types of Join: (1) Probabilistic join: Here, it is assumed that each item is associated with a range of possible values and a probability density function, which qualifies the behavior of the data over that range. (2) Similarity join: The join is performed based on the distance between the two items.
